name: Forgiving Sins
overview: Scripture teaches that forgiving sins is essential for receiving God's forgiveness, as Jesus instructs us to forgive others as we seek forgiveness ourselves (Matthew 6:12; Luke 6:37). Forgiveness is not limited in measure but is to be extended continually, as Peter’s question about forgiving 'seven times' reveals (Matthew 18:21). Believers are called to forgive those who repent after sinning against them (Luke 17:3) and to forgive others so that their own prayers and relationship with the Father may be unhindered (Mark 11:25). Repentance and baptism are also connected to the remission of sins and the reception of the Holy Spirit (Acts 2:38), highlighting the transformative power of forgiveness through Christ.
